runtimeRequiredTaint.description: Runtime-required taint as key=value:effect or key:effect. The key has no DNS prefix and is at most 53 characters, because the operator names the nodewright.nvidia.com/autoTaint_<key> node annotation after it; the value is a label value; the effect is NoSchedule, PreferNoSchedule, or NoExecute. The operator refuses to start with any other value.
